scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test:core && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & api_pid=$!; trap 'kill $api_pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM; npm run dev:web; wait $api_pid
